exam_scheme.note: RRB NTPC recruitment consists of 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-1, screening, 100 marks), 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-2, separate for each Pay Level, 120 marks), Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT) for Station Master/Traffic Assistant or Typing Skill Test for clerical posts, followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination. Negative marking of 1/3 (0.33) marks applies for each incorrect response in CBT-1 and CBT-2.

financial_package.pay_source_label: 7th CPC Pay Matrix, Railway Civilian Employees, Government of India
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated at Level 6 entry basic pay (₹35,400) for Station Master and Commercial Apprentice posts with 58% DA. Other posts span Pay Level 2 (₹19,900 basic), Level 3 (₹21,700 basic), and Level 5 (₹29,200 basic). Running staff (Goods Train Manager) receive substantial Running Allowances (KMA) and Night Duty Allowances.
official_perks: Railway residential quarters or House Rent Allowance (27%/18%/9%)
All-India free Railway Privilege Passes and PTOs for self and family across Indian Railways network
Free medical treatment in Indian Railway Hospitals and Health Units
Night Duty Allowance, National Holiday Allowance, and Running Allowance (for operational cadres)
Defined contribution retirement benefits under National Pension System (NPS)

competition_benchmarks.note: RRB NTPC holds world-record applicant volumes for public service recruitment. The 2024 recruitment cycle announced 11,558 vacancies across Graduate (CEN 05/2024: 8,113 posts) and Undergraduate (CEN 06/2024: 3,445 posts) categories. In the previous CEN 01/2019 recruitment, over 1.25 crore candidates registered for 35,281 vacancies.
